name: Salach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Salach (a blue lion on yellow).
history: The use of the arms of the lords of Staufeneck as municipal arms was proposed by the Archivdirektion Stuttgart in 1912; arms and the blue-yellow flag were approved by the Minister of the Interior on 7 March 1960.

features.role: Salach arms — blue lion on yellow
